description: List events that exhausted all retry attempts (dead-letter queue). Live keys only: a test key gets 403 LIVE_KEY_REQUIRED, since a dead letter carries the failed payload. These are events that failed delivery and were never received by your endpoint. replay_webhook_dead_letter resends one. In a message.received or email.received payload, the sender's text is wrapped in an untrusted-content tag, because a third party wrote it.

include_replayed.description: Include events that have been successfully replayed (default false).

name: list_webhook_dead_letters
title: List webhook dead letters
